user.title: Choose your Huawei Scale 3
user.description: The scale only shows up while someone is standing on it. Step on it now and reopen this dialog if it is not listed, or type its Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Huawei Scale 3
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found {name} ({address}). Next you will enter your profile.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: The scale needs your sex, age and height before it can measure, and the integration uses them to calculate body composition. The starting weight is only used until the first measurement.

data_description.birth_date: Type it as YYYY-MM-DD (1985-03-27) or DD/MM/YYYY (27/03/1985).

reauth_confirm.title: Authentication failed
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the authentication several times in a row. Enter a custom key (CAK, C1 and C2 concatenated, 96 hexadecimal characters) to override the built-in one, or leave this blank to retry with the built-in key.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_key: Enter exactly 96 hexadecimal characters (CAK, C1 and C2 concatenated), or leave it blank.
error.name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.
error.invalid_birth_date: Enter a valid date of birth in the past, as YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Huawei Scale 3.

settings.title: Behaviour
settings.description: History import fires an event for measurements stored on the scale that were taken while Home Assistant could not hear it. The cool-down stops the scale being re-read straight after a weigh-in. A scale that was never paired with the Huawei Health app has no owner and may refuse to measure; binding writes a made-up owner ID to it, which stays until the scale is factory-reset and may stop Huawei Health pairing with it later.
